overview_description.description: Agency Tool Company develops software infrastructure for robotics teams. Its ATC Deploy product delivers operating system images, container images, file bundles, configurations, models, and other artifacts to robots and manages rollout, rollback, fleet segmentation, and deployment visibility. Its ATC Build product provides hosted continuous-integration runners using embedded hardware such as NVIDIA Jetson platforms, allowing teams to test software on target hardware. The products integrate with common robotics software, container, source-control, and CI workflows.
